name: Suzy Says! [HORROR]
desc:
Mom's at work. Your uncle sent over an old TV game. Do what Suzy says... but ONLY when Suzy says. 📺

A scary game of Simon Says with a horror story. October 2003: you're home alone, and Suzy wants to be your BEST friend. Follow her orders, don't get tricked, and hide before it finds you.

👥 Play solo or co-op with up to 4 friends
🎬 Story mode with 2 endings
♾️ Endless mode: how long can you last?
🎧 Headphones recommended
⚠️ Jumpscares, loud sounds and flashing lights

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

llm.loop: follow Suzy's TV commands only when Suzy says -> avoid being tricked -> hide when the monster comes -> progress the story or last in endless mode
llm.objectives: survive Suzy's Simon Says and reach one of 2 endings, or last as long as possible in endless
llm.progression: story chapters with 2 endings; endless survival
llm.instructions: do what Suzy says but only when Suzy says; don't get tricked; hide before it finds you
unique: horror Simon Says game with a 2003 haunted TV game story
llm.thumbnails: half-creepy cartoon girl face, old CRT TV with colourful game mat in dark bedroom, shadowy monster in doorway
llm.complexity_notes: scripted story with 2 endings, monster ai, atmosphere and audio, endless mode
